description: Create a deck. Formats: commander | pdh (Pauper Commander) | dc (Duel Commander) | standard | pioneer | modern | premodern | legacy | vintage | pauper | casual (default casual). A location of kind "deck" with the same name is created automatically — sleeved cards physically live there. For commander, pdh and dc decks pass the commander as a card reference; it is added to the deck list automatically. A pair (Partner, "Choose a Background" + a Background, Doctor's companion + a Doctor) goes in commander + partner. A companion (Lurrus, Yorion, …) goes in companion: it is added to the sideboard (outside the 100 in a commander format, one of the 15 elsewhere), and deck_health checks its condition: a card that breaks it makes the deck not legal, and the issue names it. Never refused for the plan: a deck past the decks the user's plan keeps editable is made with its list and answers editable:false and plan_limit, which names the decks that take edits: relay it.
